title: Cult of Calia pt. 3: Resist or Accept
description:
You're free to leave my cult at any time. You know that, don't you? But you really do need to be sure, to understand why you'd want to do that. I offer so, so much to you, such delight, such bliss.

Why would you want to leave that? Though you're free to do so if you wish. Perhaps you want to resist... or accept my teachings and power.

Either way, this experience will bring you pleasure untold as you prepare yourself for the final stage of the Cult, the path from apprentice to zealot.

CW: This is part of a series that uses the 'cult' theme. I want to make it clear that I do not endorse cults in any way. This is not a series about creating a real life 'cult of Calia', rather it is a dark fantasy/mystery series with some creepy vibes, and is not meant to be taken seriously. As such, there are no attached tasks, or mass interaction.
author: Mistress Calia
